segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הָעוֹמֶר הָיָה בָּא עִשָּׂרוֹן מִשָּׁלֹשׁ סְאִין, שְׁתֵּי הַלֶּחֶם שְׁתֵּי עֶשְׂרוֹנִים מִשָּׁלֹשׁ סְאִין, לֶחֶם הַפָּנִים עֶשְׂרִים וְאַרְבַּע עֶשְׂרוֹנִים מֵעֶשְׂרִים וְאַרְבַּע סְאִין.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «The omer offering,» i.e., the measure of barley brought as a communal offering on the sixteenth of Nisan, «would come» from «a tenth» of an ephah of flour sifted «from three se’a» of barley. «The two loaves» would come from «two-tenths» of an ephah of flour sifted «from three se’a» of wheat. «The shewbread» would come from «twenty-four tenths» of an ephah of flour sifted «from twenty-four se’a» of wheat.

moves.cueHe: העומר היה בא עשרון משלש סאין

positions.claim: omer: a tenth from three se'a; two loaves: two tenths from three se'a; shewbread: twenty-four tenths from twenty-four se'a
